scope: Node CPU-only actual editable wall geometry and Three Raycaster; no DOM, Canvas, GPU FPS, native Tauri or input-latency claim
resultSummary: 在含 96 个真实窗洞、9692 个三角面的墙体上，BVH 构建耗时 9.21 ms；每批 96 条射线，原生拾取均值 36.14 ms、BVH 均值 0.165 ms。96 组最近命中结果及面编号、UV、法线一致，原索引和材质分组不变，构建与释放各一次且活引用归零。这只是该高洞口 CPU fixture 的观察值，不代表普通墙体、整机帧率、原生桌面表现或性能验收通过；Windows 的短批次 CPU 计数分辨率不足，持续时间采用 performance.now。

correctness.nativeClosestSelection: Three native Mesh.raycast plus Raycaster distance sorting

limitations: This deliberately stresses one wall with many real openings; it does not measure multi-object broad-phase traversal or ordinary low-triangle walls.
Construction cost is reported separately, rather than hidden inside a speedup claim.
Per-batch durations use performance.now. Separate process CPU counters can be coarse, particularly on Windows, and include process-wide activity.
This is an observed CPU measurement, not a formal performance pass; no minimum target or reference hardware has been approved.
Mesh.raycast is switched only on the benchmark-owned instance. No Three prototype or global raycaster is modified.
